app.syncErrorBanner: Couldn't save your last change to the server. Check your connection — it'll retry on your next edit.

groupDesc.tasks: Track and schedule what you need to do

badgeTitle.setup: Type in your info here — every other tab reads from it
badgeTitle.auto: Fills in automatically from what you enter elsewhere — nothing to type here

overview.title: Overview
overview.sub: Set these once. Every other tab reads from them.

setup.title: Setup
setup.note: the only settings in the whole planner
setup.name: Your name
setup.birthdayHint: optional — just for a nice surprise on the day
setup.genderHint: Selecting Female adds a Cycle Tracker tab
setup.timezoneHint: Detected from this device automatically — only change it if that's wrong

goals.title: Your goals
goals.note: target dates land on the calendar; progress feeds the dashboard
goals.emptyNote: Add one below to start tracking progress toward it.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.sub: Every number here is counted from the other tabs. Edit anything anywhere and this page follows.

hero.nothingDue: Nothing due or overdue right now.

kpi.tasksCompleteExplain: Completed one-off tasks (from Task Tracker) divided by all your non-cancelled tasks.
kpi.habitsExplain: Average completion rate across all habits this month, from the Habit Tracker.
kpi.goalProgressExplain: Average of every goal's current value divided by its target, from Overview.
kpi.leftToSpendExplain: This month's income minus paid bills and logged expenses.

dueTable.title: Due today and overdue
dueTable.note: tick a recurring one and it rolls forward

badges.title: Badges
badges.note: points: 10 per task, 15 per focus session, 5 per habit tick

today.title: Today
today.subToday: Pulled together from Task Tracker, Bills, Habit Tracker, and your Fitness split — tick something here and it's ticked there too.
today.subDayDetail: Whatever was (or is) due that day, its journal entry, and its spending — clicked from the Monthly Calendar.

kpi.stillOpenExplain: Rows still showing in the checklist below.
kpi.focusSessionsExplain: 30-minute focus timer sessions completed, from the timer above.
kpi.spentExplain: Logged in the Spending table below, for this date only.
kpi.fromHealthExplain: Sent in by an Apple Shortcut you set up on Overview — not tracked directly in Align.

auth.setupHint: Takes about 2 minutes once you're in — a short guided setup, skip anytime.

notice.signUpCheckEmail: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in.
notice.resetCheckEmail: Check your email for a password reset link.

error.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match — double-check them, or use "Forgot password?" below.
error.alreadyRegistered: An account with that email already exists — try signing in instead.
error.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email first — check your inbox for the link we sent when you signed up.
error.passwordTooShort: That password is too short — use at least 6 characters.
error.rateLimit: Too many attempts in a row — wait a minute and try again.
error.network: Couldn't reach the server — check your connection and try again.
error.genericSignUp: Couldn't create your account. Try again.
